verses.31:18: وَلَا تُصَعِّرۡ خَدَّكَ لِلنَّاسِ وَلَا تَمۡشِ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مَرَحًاۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخۡتَالࣲ فَخُورࣲ‏

meaning: The root خدد primarily refers to making a furrow or groove in the ground, like a track or a ditch. It can also describe a deep cut or mark on a surface, or a wrinkle on the skin.
en_note: Statistically derived from translation co-occurrence, not a lexical definition. Highlighting only.
